mapper.select: SELECT config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = #{key}
SELECT config_key, config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key LIKE 'vi.biz.%' ORDER BY config_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type) VALUES (#{key}, #{key}, #{value}, 'N') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = #{value}, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type) SELECT 'vi.config.version', 'vi.config.version', '0', 'N' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = 'vi.config.version')
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM sys_config WHERE config_key = 'vi.config.version'), '0')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_value = #{next}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_key = 'vi.config.version' AND config_value = #{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT dict_value, dict_label, dict_sort, status FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND status = '0' ORDER BY dict_sort
